title: Production-Ready Evals
description: A practical breakdown of how to design and run evals that hold up in production — not just demos. Covers deterministic assertions, failure modes, and coverage gaps.

title: ColBERT: Late Interaction Retrieval
description: How ColBERT's late interaction mechanism changes the retrieval tradeoff — keeping full token-level expressiveness without the cost of cross-encoder inference at query time.

title: Adversarial Validation
description: Using adversarial validation to detect train/test distribution shift before it silently breaks your model in production. A technique that turns data leakage into a measurable signal.

title: PAHF: Personalized AI Feedback
description: The system design behind persistent, preference-aware AI drafting — and why naively re-prompting a model with user corrections fails every time.
